name: PubLayNet
description: PubLayNet is a large-scale dataset for document layout analysis containing over 360,000 document images automatically generated by matching PubMed Central PDF articles with XML representations. It includes bounding boxes for 5 typical document layout categories: Text, Title, List, Table, and Figure.
